- An award-winning culture!  We are rated a Top Workplace by the Chicago Tribune (past 12 years) and Employee Recommended award by the Globe & Mail (past 6 years)

- Comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, vision, life, a 401k plan with a generous company matches and tuition reimbursement to name a few

The Relationship Manager, Business Banking is responsible for acquisition, retention, and expansion of new and existing loan, deposit, and treasury relationships. This role provides exceptional customer service by taking ownership of the customer experience.

- Build and manage a professional network of COI’s and referral sources

- Exceptional oral and written communications skills

- Strong interpersonal skills with a proven ability establishing client relationships

- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to proactively manage and prioritize workflow

Position Overview:

This position serves as the primary leader for Commercial and Wealth deposit pricing governance, profitability analytics, and strategic pricing execution. The role partners across Treasury, Finance, Product, and frontline business teams to deliver data-driven pricing strategies that support sustainable growth, funding optimization, and relationship profitability.

What you’ll do:

Commercial & Wealth Deposit Pricing Strategy Execution

- Execute pricing strategies across Commercial, Wealth, Treasury Management, and Business Banking deposit portfolios.
- Recommend pricing actions based on market dynamics, client behaviors, competitive intelligence, and rate environments.
- Support development of segmentation, relationship pricing, and portfolio optimization strategies.
- Partner with Product Managers to align pricing initiatives with product objectives.
- Monitor pricing performance and recommend modifications to improve profitability and growth.
- Support enterprise deposit growth, retention, and funding objectives.

Pricing Governance & Controls

- Administer enterprise pricing governance policies and procedures.
- Lead pricing exception review processes.
- Facilitate Deposit Pricing Committee meetings.
- Maintain approval authorities and escalation standards.
- Produce governance reporting for executive management.
- Ensure pricing decisions align with internal controls and risk standards.
- Coordinate with Compliance, Audit, Legal, and Risk Management team

Commercial & Wealth LOB Advisory

- Advise bankers and market leaders on complex relationship pricing opportunities.

- Provide profitability analysis on strategic client relationships.

- Support negotiations involving significant deposit relationships.

- Evaluate relationship economics and return profiles.

- Assist with pricing recommendations for large and competitive opportunities.

- Promote consistent pricing discipline across the organization.

Deposit Analytics & Decision Support

- Lead development of pricing and profitability reporting.
- Build dashboards measuring portfolio performance.
- Analyze deposit trends, pricing effectiveness, and competitive positioning.
- Develop forecasting and scenario modeling capabilities.
- Deliver executive-level insights and recommendations.
- Support strategic initiatives through advanced analytics.

Treasury & Balance Sheet Partnership

- Partner with Treasury on pricing, funding and liquidity objectives.
- Support ALCO reporting and analysis.
- Evaluate deposit beta, migration, retention, and sensitivity trends.
- Contribute to budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning activities.
- Assess pricing impacts on balance sheet performance

- Vendor management, industry trends, business case writing and road map management

- Strong expertise in collaborative work environment

- Experience translating data into executive-level insights

- Proven ability to lead large projects to execution

- Experience with Curinos, Zafin, FIS IBS, XAA, Brinks a positive

jobs.title: VP, Business Strategy - WLF
jobs.description:
As the largest life insurance premium finance company in the country, Wintrust Life Finance provides customized financing solutions to qualified borrowers seeking to finance their life insurance premiums. Our financing solutions have supported numerous planning structures, including traditional wealth transfer, key-man insurance, buy-sell arrangements, split dollar arrangements, term alternatives, charitable giving, income replacement strategies, and more. Wintrust Life Finance is a subsidiary of Wintrust, a financial services company with more than $66 billion in assets.

The WLF VP, Business Strategy , is responsible for collaborating with key stakeholders in the analysis, formulation and execution of WLF’s strategic plan. Key aspects of this position focus on completing life premium finance market research, analysis, reporting, strategic initiative development, project & product management, and delivering regularly scheduled reports and presentations in collaboration with department EVP.

What You'll Do

Strategy & Strategic Planning:
- Manage WLFs process efficiency and strategy administration team
- Collect and analyze premium finance data related to strategic plan and generate insights to initiate strategic development activities
- Complete regularly scheduled market research in support of strategic plan
- Collaborate with departments to evaluate operations to identify growth and development opportunities
- Monitor and evaluate the performance of the company’s strategies, initiatives, and objectives and report findings to executive leaders
- Help drive decision making resulting in medium- and long-term process improvements
- Proactively present business findings, projections and make recommendations to department EVP and other leaders as appropriate
- Support EVP in developing and communicating WLFs strategic initiatives, including but not limited to presentations, financial reports, and models in both written and verbal formats
- Lead effective, efficient meetings with clients, prospects, and WLFs Strategic Initiative Owners to drive strategic plan efforts
- In conjunctions with department EVP, act as an internal dot connector, working with project managers to ensure internal resources are collaborative and projects/work streams are on time and in line with expectations
- Partner with WLFs Strategic Initiative Owners, Wintrust’s ePMO and Wintrust Oversight teams (ePMO, TPRM, IC, CC, IPA, ASRB and InfoSec) to drive strategic level project approval and implementation

Product Development & WLF Business Line Support:
- Drive internal understanding of key customer personas and engage with clients/prospects to better understand workflows. Synthesize learnings to internal stakeholders to drive and facilitate loan growth
- Partner with Sales, Sales Leadership and Client Success teams to define, enhance, track and drive product adoption
- Through the lens of the Strategic Plan build Product Level KPIs to define, monitor and manage success
- Support optimization modeling and process planning in collaboration with team level management, outside sales and internal stakeholders. Evaluate premium tiers for client/prospects, calculate quote conversation ratios, average down payments, installments, and price to deliver actionable recommendations in identifying growth opportunities

Foster a culture of collaboration and process improvement:
- Look for opportunities, identify gaps and scale efficiencies and new ways of working across multiple projects and environments
- Influence and facilitate the creation of long-term relationships with other departments and vendors
- Source data to make compelling and tangible recommendations of a future state for the organization
- Leverage relationships and organizational values to prioritize outcomes effectively
- Employ practical methods and action steps to move the organization toward the strategic vision
- Help Identify obstacles to transformation and challenge conventional thinking

Qualifications
- 10-15 years of experience in the Financial Industry
- Premium Financial experience preferred
- Experience owning a strategic initiative from concept to completion
- Bachelor's Degree required
- MBA Preferred
- Onsite position

Compensation

What You’ll Do:

The Program Manager, People & Culture role is instrumental in driving the growth and sustainability of our Wintrust commitment and mission of building a high-performance culture that focused on people and powered by inclusion. This position will primarily focus on managing the Business Resource Groups (BRGs). In addition, the Program Manager will oversee our mentoring and sponsorship programs, manage internal and external communications related to inclusion initiatives, and be responsible for nurturing our strategic partnerships. Emphasis would be on developing and managing programs that target Wintrust team members across the enterprise ensuring inclusive practices are integrated in our workforce, workplace, and community. The role reports directly to the Senior Vice President, People & Culture, with expectations for close alignment and collaboration with the Human Resources and senior leaders as well as effectively partnering with other key stakeholder groups to ensure sound execution, visibility, and engagement by all employees as we continue to foster an inclusive culture.

Strategy & Planning

- Develops, implements and manages innovative inclusion practices, programs and initiatives.

- Take ownership of Business Resource Groups, ensuring its continuous growth and evolution with focus on operationalizing the program.

- Provide oversight and project management to support the expansion of internal mentoring and sponsorship programs ensuring their ongoing success and effectiveness.

- Partner with internal subject matter experts to formulate initiatives that enhance a culture of high performance, inclusion, cultural agility, engagement and retention.

Stakeholder Engagement

- Partner with HR Business Partners and other key stakeholders to identify opportunities for advancing inclusion objectives organization wide.

- Partner with Leadership Development, and other HR Centers of Excellence as needed, to design and deliver programs that support multicultural leadership pipeline development and retention, and other inclusive outcomes.

- Manage strategic partnerships in collaboration with Talent Acquisition for enhanced talent sourcing and development options, particularly targeting women, professionals of color, veterans and individuals with disabilities.

Communication & Awareness

- Collaborate with Marketing, Internal Communications and Community Impact to ensure awareness and visibility of key initiatives and programs.

- Develop impactful and creative inclusion content for various communication channels (newsletters, intranet posts, email blasts, etc.,) for internal and external audiences.

- Represent Wintrust at high-visibility staffing events, such as campus visits, career fairs, panels, and conferences, etc.

- Bachelor’s Degree and/or equivalent combination of education and work experience in Business, Human Resources, Organizational Development/Change Management, diversity and inclusion programming, communication, professional development, or leadership development.

- Ability to operate in a self-directed manner, manage multiple priorities, and work in a decentralized and fast-paced environment.

- Ability to establish productive working relationships at all levels of the organization, and across all business units.
